mcp_tools.name: behavioral_finance_debiasing
mcp_tools.title: Behavioral finance debiasing
mcp_tools.description: Submits a behavioural-finance debiasing manifest (bias screening against the skill's catalogue, found bias patterns, prospect-theory reframing, precommitment with rebalancing band, journal and checklists, whole-portfolio view, guardrails) and returns a deterministic DEBIASED / NOT_DEBIASED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including a computed rebalancing-drift versus caller-declared band check and a report-only position-share figure, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The behavioural-finance debiasing manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

bias_screening.description: Bias-screening evidence (one field per catalogued bias).

whole_portfolio.description: Whole-portfolio evidence, including position and portfolio values.

expect.notes: All checks pass. Computed spot checks: position_share_percent_of_portfolio = 10.0000, allocation_drift_over_band_percent = -1.0000.
